title: GraphSchema
description: Contract 3: The schema-introspection response. Describes all vertex types, edge types, attributes, cardinalities, and graph-level statistics in a backend-agnostic form, so agents and LLMs can reason about the graph without a backend-specific query language.

protocol.description: The protocol version identifier. Must be 'graphrag/1.0'.

graph_id.description: Identifier of the graph this schema describes.

vertex_types.description: All vertex (entity) types in the graph with their attributes and counts.

edge_types.description: All edge (relationship) types in the graph with their source/target cardinalities.

EntityType.description: A vertex type with its attributes and instance count.

count.description: Number of instances of this vertex type.

primary_key.description: Name of the attribute that serves as the entity's primary key.

attributes.description: List of attribute definitions for this vertex type.

sample.description: An optional example instance of this vertex type for LLM context.

RelationshipType.description: An edge type with its source/target vertex types and instance count.

source.description: Source vertex type for this edge.

target.description: Target vertex type for this edge.

count.description: Number of instances of this edge type.

attributes.description: List of attribute definitions for this edge type.

type.description: Attribute data type (e.g., STRING, INT, FLOAT, DATETIME).

nullable.description: Whether the attribute may be null.

total_vertices.description: Total number of vertices across all types.

total_edges.description: Total number of edges across all types.

avg_degree.description: Average degree of vertices in the graph.

connected_components.description: Number of connected components in the graph.
